## Observed compatibility blocker

The fresh Dependabot updates in [PR #191](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-slack-standup/pull/191) and [PR #192](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-slack-standup/pull/192) replace one reusable-workflow SHA and its annotation with `a935d7b9cefde7c5099e552914653217e1024c3f # v2026.11.02`.

The [upstream tag reference](https://api.github.com/repos/unbraind/pm-github/git/ref/tags/v2026.11.02) was independently checked and resolves to that exact commit. The annotation is truthful, but this repository's inherited strict SemVer-style annotation rule rejects the padded day.

## Exact tested revisions and evidence

- #191 head: `d8559d4f72d30aa24287744ff7c8bede97e403bf`; tested synthetic merge: `f43d824915c179b8562da26d96cdf1206894a6a2`.
  [Node 26 log](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-slack-standup/actions/runs/42177363298/job/127758791854), [Node 22.18.0 stages](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-slack-standup/actions/runs/42177363298/job/127758791642).
- #192 head: `5708cedab3cf34169a9508843ba92699f468583a`; tested synthetic merge: `2ab293842f08b5fdf034369b4755fa8050d6929b`.
  [Node 26 log](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-slack-standup/actions/runs/42177368494/job/127758807506), [Node 22.18.0 stages](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-slack-standup/actions/runs/42177368494/job/127758807481).

Both tested merges use base `9d9e71563fc9fef4a6d36d85c229f1cf0ad82613`. Heads and latest checks were rechecked on 2026-11-06 and remain unchanged.

Each inspected Node 26 log reports **358 tests, 357 passing, one failing**. The workflow-inventory test fails at `test/workflow-security.test.ts:55`, through the version-comment assertion at line 41:

```text
actual: 'v2026.11.02'
expected: /^v(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)$/
```

The named failing reference is respectively `pm-github-closeout.yml` or `pm-github-sync.yml`. Node 22 stage receipts separately confirm a failed full release gate after build and skipped later Bun-install validation; its failure detail was not independently read from a full log.

## Source goal, expected and actual

[The pin policy](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-slack-standup/blob/d8559d4f72d30aa24287744ff7c8bede97e403bf/docs/action-pins.md) and [canonical record pm-slack-standup-6wvl](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-slack-standup/blob/af2bfa787c66d36ac61ccde778f20f29ce291b45/.agents/pm/issues/pm-slack-standup-6wvl.toon) replace a frozen commit allow-list with trusted-owner, immutable-SHA and annotation properties so future Dependabot updates can proceed.

The [current validator](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-slack-standup/blob/d8559d4f72d30aa24287744ff7c8bede97e403bf/test/workflow-security.test.ts#L35-L44) is byte-identical at both failed heads and current default `af2bfa787c66d36ac61ccde778f20f29ce291b45`. Its leading-zero rejection is intentional, including a negative `v07.1.0` fixture. This finding does not claim the implementation violates its existing strict policy. It identifies an omitted compatibility rule for truthful padded CalVer tags now emitted by Dependabot.

Expected: an explicit, documented handling of these legitimate calendar-version annotations while retaining immutable pin and provenance checks. Actual: both proposals are blocked by annotation syntax alone. The handling is proposed follow-up work, not a verified fix.

## Acceptance and limits

- Define and test the intended CalVer handling or annotation-normalization contract. Cover both actual Dependabot workflow diffs and the exact upstream tag/SHA relationship.
- Retain trusted-owner/full-40-hex-SHA requirements, same-line formatting, YAML-location validation, aliases/multiline refusals and meaningful malformed-version/observed-tag mismatch tests. Avoid a blanket relaxation of the security policy.
- Preserve strict ordinary SemVer checks where intended, with explicit padded-calendar positive and malformed-version negative cases.
- Pass complete Node 22/26 and downstream npm/Bun acceptance on one immutable corrected head, identifying any remaining independent blockers.

This is hosted CI evidence plus static inspection. No local tests, installs, workflow dispatches, live sync/closeout calls, source changes or merges were performed. It does not establish a standup runtime regression, a security bypass or successful execution of later release stages.

## Deduplication

All 192 all-status issue/PR records, current #191/#192 discussions, the complete #131 discussion and all 112 canonical records at current default were checked; all canonical Git blob hashes were verified. Closed [PR #131](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-slack-standup/pull/131)/pm-slack-standup-6wvl owns the inherited policy, but no existing owner for this specific padded-CalVer compatibility case was found.
Strict version-comment check blocks truthful padded CalVer workflow updates
